candidate_sentences.text: However, profitability declined materially.
Operating profit fell 25.7% to EUR 13.6 million, adjusted EBITDA decreased 13.5% to EUR 25.8 million, and profit for the period declined 41.7% to EUR 6.0 million.

Comparability was negatively affected by the prior-year EUR 0.9 million profit from the sale of land for the Rail Baltica project and a EUR 0.9 million insurance indemnity related to Botnica repairs; neither benefited 2026.
These factors, together with higher expenses and depreciation, outweighed revenue growth.
